title: PRIVATE TOUR HOKKAIDO - SAPPORO
route: Sapporo - Otaru - Asahikawa - Bibai - Furano - Noboribetsu

includes: Professional Licensed Driver (Japanese Speaking) (10 Hours Basis)
excludes: Extra Hours Transport & Tour Guide: 5,000 - 10,000 yen per hour
Infant car seat (RM197 per day) — compulsory

itinerary.title: Arrival - Sapporo Tour
activities: Odori Park (a park in the middle of a business district)
Sapporo TV Tower (Sapporo's landmark with an observation deck and souvenir shop)

itinerary.title: Otaru Tour
activities: Otaru Canal (a canal lined with red brick warehouses)
Sakaimachi Street (street with workshops, souvenir shops and cafes)

itinerary.title: Central Hokkaido Tour
activities: Asahiyama Zoo (famous in Hokkaido for its Walking Penguin Show during winter)
Shirogane Blue Pond (vibrant turquoise pond in Biei)
Ningle Terrace (souvenir store and cafe in a wooden cabin setting)

sub: Bibai Snowland (snow tubing, snow rafting, mini snowmobiles and more)
Jigokudani Hell Valley (the infamous boiling springs)
Date Jidaimura Village (Edo-period history park with traditional performances, foods and activities)

expect.title: Meals Excluded
expect.body: No breakfast, lunch or dinner. The guide will bring you to a halal-friendly restaurant or convenience store.

expect.title: Airport Transfer
expect.body: Please bring a maximum of 1 luggage per person, as it affects car capacity.

expect.title: Tour Guide & Transport
expect.body: 10 hours basis. 5,000 - 10,000 yen will be charged for each extra hour.

entries: All prices are valid for 24 hours after quotation submission.
The price is for 2 to 3 persons per room.
Late booking surcharge of RM50/booking will be charged if the booking is made less than 45 days before departure.
Last minute surcharge will be charged if the booking is made less than 3 weeks before departure (refer to the Last Minute Surcharge table).
Private driver & guide is based on 10 hours basis. 5,000 - 10,000 yen will be charged for every extra hour usage. Payment must be made in cash.
Itinerary, price and flight are subject to change accordingly.
The itinerary stated may change on tour day without prior notice, subject to weather and current traffic conditions.
Final itinerary and hotel arrangements 14 days before the trip.
Please check with our staff on the trip validity before booking any connecting domestic flights.
This package is valid until 31 January 2027 travel period.

deposit.text: prior to departure for full payment
